query: select s.name as subject_name, ct.theme, count(*) as citation_count from public.citations c join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where c.created_at = '2026-08-20 21:03:54.235981+00'::timestamptz group by s.name, ct.theme order by s.name, ct.theme limit 50;
